facts.fact: The Ijwi ry'Ikirundi AI repository publishes a free public version of a Kirundi dataset (1,813 sentences with AI drafts, CC BY-NC 4.0), from a private full set of 4,809 sentences and 2,996 complete Kirundi-French-English pairs, and names its own NLLB-based Kirundi translation model.

systems.system: Kirundi Open Speech & Text Dataset / nllb-kirundi-multi
